clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Wetlands, Scorched Spider Fangs are taken from Cave Stalkers and Leech Stalkers. Furen Longbeard in Stormwind needs fifty to strengthen mail for Alliance warriors.

In Stormwind, blacksmith Furen Longbeard uses unusual methods to strengthen mail. He calls for fifty scorched fangs from the giant spiders of the Wetlands. Their dense, venomous, toughened substance reinforces the mail links as he tempers them.

Cave Stalkers and Leech Stalkers bear the fangs Furen needs. They live in the Wetlands' sunken valleys and burrows, where damp and rot surround their hardened, scorched mandibles. Gathering fifty means venturing into deep hollows and facing the spiders in their swarms.
